stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Biometric system metrics · real-time updates
stats.auto_tooltip: Automatically updates statistics at the chosen interval.
stats.card_persons_desc: Total people registered in the system.
stats.card_events_desc: Recognition events recorded (webcam, video or image).
stats.card_rate_desc: Percentage of events that ended in a match with a registered person.
stats.chart_growth_desc: Evolution of total registered persons over time.
stats.chart_activity_desc: Recognitions recorded per day in the selected period.
stats.chart_origin_desc: Share of events by source: live webcam, video analysis or photo search.
stats.chart_confidence_desc: Histogram of match similarity (%). Values near 100 indicate very confident matches.
stats.card_with_photos_desc: People with at least one photo in the dataset.
stats.card_without_photos_desc: Registered people without a biometric dataset (no recognition).
stats.card_embeddings_desc: Biometric vectors extracted from photos (one per usable photo).
stats.chart_growth_full_desc: Cumulative total of registered persons over time.
stats.chart_company_desc: Distribution of persons by registered company.
stats.chart_sex_desc: Distribution of persons by the sex recorded in their profile.
stats.chart_role_desc: Distribution of persons by occupational role.
stats.chart_attrs_desc: Persons presenting each attribute (glasses, beard, smile…) based on their main photo.
stats.chart_eye_color_desc: Distribution of persons by the estimated eye color in their main photo.
stats.chart_hair_color_desc: Distribution of persons by the estimated hair color in their main photo.
stats.card_events_period_desc: Total recognition events in the selected period.
stats.card_matches_desc: Events that matched a registered person.
stats.card_unknown_desc: Events where the person could not be identified.
stats.card_rate_period_desc: Percentage of matches within the selected period.
stats.chart_weekday_desc: Recognitions by weekday (helps to spot peak usage days).
stats.chart_hour_desc: Recognitions by hour of day. Colors: night (red), early morning (orange), morning (blue), afternoon (green).
stats.chart_top_desc: People with the highest number of matches in the system.
stats.chart_conf_time_desc: Evolution of average match similarity per day.
stats.chart_conf_origin_desc: Average match similarity by source (webcam, video or image).
stats.chart_match_unknown_desc: Share of identified events vs. unknown in the period.
